issues.description: The problem specification and the template expect a parameterless messageOnRide() returning a String (UML and example Main call use r.messageOnRide()), but the solution defines Rideable.messageOnRide(int speed) and implements it in Pig and Seal with an int parameter. This parameter mismatch will cause compilation/signature errors or test failures when students (or tests) call messageOnRide() without an argument.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable.messageOnRide signature consistent with the problem and template by removing the int parameter (declare messageOnRide() : String). Update the solution implementations (Pig and Seal) to implement the parameterless messageOnRide() and return the expected format "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"; or alternatively, if speed is intended, update the problem statement and template Main examples to include the speed parameter everywhere.
